items.title: 21.11 Global Climate and Energy Transfer from the Sun

source_refs.note: Topic 21.11 with the subheadings 1. Earth's Energy Budget and 2. Energy Imbalance between the Poles and Equator, Figs. 21.12-21.13 and the Do you know? box (PDF 179-181), as printed.

blocks.text: Energy received from the Sun plays a important role in producing changes in the global climate. Here, we will briefly describe how energy received from the Sun is distributed on Earth and how uneven heating of Earth between equator and poles can produce atmospheric changes.
